passages.title: The Pencil Case on the Art Cart
passages.focus: Aoi identifies a misplaced pencil case by matching a small animal sticker with the class supply record.

passages.title: A Red Clip on the Homework Box
passages.focus: Yuki checks a red clip and the board instructions to learn which homework box is for late work.

passages.title: The Shoes beside the Stage
passages.focus: Ken avoids taking similar indoor shoes by checking class numbers before rehearsal.

passages.title: The Light Left On in Room Two
passages.focus: Maya checks the club schedule and a cleaning note before assuming someone forgot to turn off a classroom light.

passages.title: Which Folder Goes to the Office?
passages.focus: Sora uses color tabs and a delivery list to choose the correct folder for the school office.

passages.title: The Name Card near the Sink
passages.focus: Hina returns a fallen name card after checking seating order and a classroom photo.

passages.title: The Bus Stop with Two Signs
passages.focus: Ryo compares route numbers and departure times before guiding a younger student to the correct school bus stop.

passages.title: A Sticker on the Science Box
passages.focus: Miku uses a moon sticker and the experiment list to return a science box to the right group.

passages.title: The Towel on the Fence
passages.focus: Taichi checks a sports-day duty chart before deciding who owns a towel left by the field.

passages.title: Why the Classroom Door Was Open
passages.focus: Nana checks a ventilation notice and lesson schedule before closing a door that was intentionally left open.

passages.title: The Lunch Tray with a Green Mark
passages.focus: Koki uses a green mark and food note to carry a special lunch tray to the correct table.

passages.title: A Number on the Library Card
passages.focus: Rina checks a card number and shelf list before returning a library card to its owner.

passages.title: The Chair Facing the Window
passages.focus: Yuma learns a chair was moved for a drawing activity by checking a teacher note and the next class plan.

passages.title: The Small Bell in the Gym Bag
passages.focus: Akari matches a small bell with the dance club inventory instead of guessing from the bag color.

passages.title: A Yellow Arrow by the Stairs
passages.focus: Kenta follows a temporary yellow arrow and learns it marks the route to a school health check.

passages.title: The Poster Taken Down Before Friday
passages.focus: Mei checks an event calendar and teacher message before putting a poster back on the wall.

passages.title: The Blue Dot on the Seating Map
passages.focus: Haruto uses a map legend to find the reserved visitor seat instead of moving another student's chair.

passages.title: The Water Bottle Return Survey
passages.focus: Students compare return locations and redesign signs after learning that users miss one station.

passages.title: A Reminder Sent at the Wrong Time
passages.focus: A club compares message-open times and changes when practice reminders are sent.

passages.title: Testing Two Hallway Routes
passages.focus: Students time two hallway routes during class changes and discover the shorter route creates a bottleneck.

passages.title: The Menu Board behind the Line
passages.focus: Students observe that customers cannot see a menu board until too late and test a new location.

passages.title: Two Versions of the Club Form
passages.focus: Students compare paper and online sign-up forms and remove a confusing optional question.

passages.title: The Sidewalk after the Snow Melted
passages.focus: Students inspect two routes and find that a shaded section stays icy longer than the sunny route.

passages.title: Why Students Skipped the Second Shelf
passages.focus: A library team observes users and moves category labels to eye level.

passages.title: The Announcement with Too Much Music
passages.focus: A broadcasting club tests an announcement and lowers background music after listeners miss key information.

passages.title: The Fast Checkout That Started Late
passages.focus: Festival staff compare checkout speed and setup delays before changing preparation order.

passages.title: The Direction Sign beside the Tree
passages.focus: Visitors miss a sign blocked by leaves, so students test a clearer position.

passages.title: Five Quiet Minutes before Practice
passages.focus: A team compares practice starts and finds a short equipment-check period reduces later interruptions.

passages.title: The Book Drive with Too Many Rules
passages.focus: Students examine rejected donations and rewrite instructions with clearer examples.

passages.title: The Entrance That Visitors Passed
passages.focus: A community room entrance looks private, so students test a welcoming sign and open-door marker.

passages.title: A Study Plan That Needed One Change
passages.focus: Students compare concentration notes and move the hardest task earlier instead of adding study time.

passages.title: The Reusable Plate Trial
passages.focus: An event team compares washing time, return rate and waste before choosing where reusable plates work best.

passages.title: The Speaker near the Courtyard
passages.focus: Students test sound in four locations and redirect one speaker after echoes hide the message.

passages.title: The Survey with a Long First Page
passages.focus: A survey team shortens its opening page after younger students stop before reaching the main questions.

passages.title: The Community Pantry Temperature Log
passages.focus: Students compare temperature records and delivery times to reduce food loss without shortening safe storage.

passages.title: The Safety Notice with an Extra Word
passages.focus: Students compare two language versions and find that one added word changes who the warning applies to.

passages.title: The Harbor Walk Event Route
passages.focus: Students combine a tide table, closed-path map and shuttle schedule to choose a safe event route.
passages.material: tide table + route map + shuttle schedule

passages.title: The Interview Answer Cut in Half
passages.focus: A newspaper team checks the full recording and corrects a quote whose omitted sentence changed the speaker's meaning.

passages.title: Two Surveys of the Same Park
passages.focus: Students reconcile different survey results by checking weekday, weather and survey location.

passages.title: The Science Center Group Plan
passages.focus: A class combines room capacities, workshop times and group sizes to make a workable visit plan.
passages.material: capacity chart + workshop timetable + floor map

passages.title: The Crop in the Corner of the Photo
passages.focus: A student reporter checks the uncropped image and revises a caption that hid an important detail.

passages.title: Keep, Repair, or Move the Bike Racks?
passages.focus: Students compare repair cost, usage and rain exposure before recommending different actions for three racks.

passages.title: The Rain-Safe Market Schedule
passages.focus: Organizers combine rainfall forecasts, covered areas and activity times to revise a community market schedule.
passages.material: hourly forecast + site map + activity timetable

passages.title: The Percentage without Its Question
passages.focus: Students trace a popular percentage to the original survey and find that the question measured a narrower behavior.

passages.title: The Community Garden Shade Record
passages.focus: Students compare sunlight and growth records and propose different planting choices for shaded and open areas.

passages.title: Three Accounts of the Lost Bag
passages.focus: A student committee separates direct observations from guesses when three witnesses describe a lost bag.

passages.title: The Audio Tour with Long Pauses
passages.focus: Volunteers compare completion data and comments, then revise pacing while keeping the same information.

passages.title: The Temporary Shelter Room Plan
passages.focus: Students combine family needs, room limits and supply delivery times to assign spaces and supplies fairly.
passages.material: family-needs table + room chart + delivery timetable

passages.title: The Graph behind the Strong Claim
passages.focus: A newspaper club softens a headline after checking that a graph supports only one part of the claim.

passages.title: The Stream Record from Two Seasons
passages.focus: Students compare water-quality records but first align measurement time and rainfall conditions before judging change.
